items.statement: Wholesale volume grew 81% from 46,000 units to 83,000 units year on year.
items.quote: This is reflecting in very strong financial results. For example, our wholesale volume grew 81%, from 46,000 units in Q1 FY 2026 to 83,000 units in Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: Tight control of fixed costs, especially marketing and sales, delivered the first ever positive EBITDA quarter.
items.quote: Recognizing the strong demand that our products already had, we were able to run a really tight ship on fixed costs, particularly marketing and sales, and deliver our first ever positive EBITDA quarter.

items.statement: Registrations grew 102% year on year, faster than the 81% wholesale growth.
items.quote: Year-on-year wholesale growth was 81%, but year-on-year registration growth was even sharper at 102%.

items.statement: Near-term commodity inflation cut gross margin by 5.6 points, more than offsetting structural gains.
items.quote: Obviously, more than canceling it out, is the near-term commodity inflation that we are dealing with, which led to a 5.6% drop in gross margins.

items.statement: Even 9.2 lakh units of annual capacity may be tight in the coming quarters on current demand.
items.quote: 9.2 lakh units per annum is only 77,000 units a month. We believe on current demand trajectories, even this may be tight in the coming quarters

items.statement: The EL launch should set up even stronger demand in the coming quarters.
items.quote: EL launch later this month should further set us up for an even stronger demand in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Management cautiously guides at least 75% AtherStack Pro attach rates on the EL scooter.
items.quote: I would cautiously guide at least 75% attach rates with EL also, but I would hope for even higher.

items.statement: Paid preorders rose 158% to a record 1.5 lakh in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Ather preorders, these are paid preorders that are captured across the country, they were up 158%, hitting a first-ever seen 1.5 lakh preorders in Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: Dealer stock fell from 14 days to 3 days because demand exceeds supply.
items.quote: Our dealer stocks are down from 14 days to 3 three days, as of Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: Average selling price rose to Rs 1.61 lakh from about Rs 1.5 lakh last quarter.
items.quote: The average sales price of Ather has now hit Rs. 1.61 lakh across the country, up from about Rs. 1.5 lakh as of last quarter.

items.statement: The ASP rise came from price hikes the market absorbed and better SKU management.
items.quote: This is a mix of, A, price hikes, which the market has been able to absorb, and B, improved SKU management on the ground.

items.statement: The company's commodity index has risen 46% over the last five quarters.
items.quote: The commodity index in the last 5 quarters has gone up by 46% for us, which is what we had roughly guided by last quarter also.

items.statement: Management sees perhaps another 100-200 bps of commodity hit still to come.
items.quote: If nothing else changes, maybe there is still 100-200 bps of further hit left.

items.statement: Adjusted gross margin landed at 22.4% in Q1.
items.quote: Net it out, we have landed up at 22.4% AGM for Q1 2027.

items.statement: Management expects no material further margin damage from raw materials in Q2.
items.quote: At a margin level, I think, we have already made a move, and in Q2, we should not see a material degradation from RM any further.

items.statement: Current facilities max out at 35,000 units a month and are running at almost full utilisation.
items.quote: Our current facilities have a max production capacity of 35,000 units, and I am happy to announce that we are almost at 100% utilization as we speak now.

items.statement: AURIC going live will raise total capacity from 4.2 lakh to 9.2 lakh units later this calendar year.
items.quote: Go-live of AURIC will take our total capacity up from 4.2 lakh units to 9.2 lakh units later this calendar year.

items.statement: AURIC Phase-2 could add another 5 lakh units, taking total capacity to 14.2 lakh units.
items.quote: With AURIC Phase-2, we can incrementally add another 5 lakh annual capacity, taking our total capacity up to 14.2 lakh units in the coming time.

items.statement: The company closed a Rs 1,300 crore QIP with strong domestic and foreign participation.
items.quote: Also to fund it, recently, we finished closure of our Rs. 1,300 crore QIP a few weeks ago with very strong participation from funds, both from India and abroad.

items.statement: A further Rs 1,200 crore preference issue will take total fundraising to Rs 2,500 crore.
items.quote: We are also in the midst of seeking shareholder approval and closing a fundraise of another Rs. 1,200 crores via preference issue, leading to a total fundraise of Rs. 2,500 crores.

items.statement: The EL scooter is in production with trials, start of production and homologation done.
items.quote: EL scooter is already under production. High volume trials have already begun. SOP has already begun. Homologation is already completed.

items.statement: EL scooter manufacturing will scale to about 60,000 units a month across Aurangabad and Hosur.
items.quote: We are looking at scaling up our manufacturing capacity for the EL scooter to about 60,000 units per month between Aurangabad and Hosur together.

items.statement: Electric two-wheeler penetration rose 44% to 11%, and electric scooter penetration is above 25%.
items.quote: E-two-wheeler penetration is up by 44% at 11% in the two-wheeler industry, and electric penetration in the scooter industry is upwards of, I believe, 25% now.

items.statement: Industry registrations rose 68% in a year to 525k in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Industry registrations are up 68% in the last one year, hitting 525k in Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: Commodity costs may rise a bit more in coming months, though management hopes they are near the top.
items.quote: We do believe that there is still some more risk in the coming months of it escalating a bit more, but we are hopefully near the top rather than near the bottom right now.

items.statement: Extension of the PM E-DRIVE subsidy is not yet confirmed, though the government has signalled intent.
items.quote: We have been hearing an intent by the government to find a way to extend PM-E-DRIVE to continue supporting the larger electrification drive

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Despite the commodity crisis, despite that pressure, we were able to manage our gross margins well.

items.statement: Adjusted gross margin for Q2 FY27 was 24%, up 1.6% from Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Netting out Q2 FY27 AGM at 24%, which is a 1.6% improvement over Q1 FY27.

items.statement: The business reported positive PAT for the first time.
items.quote: And I would be remiss in not acknowledging the first time our business hit positive PAT something definitely worth celebrating for us.

items.statement: Commodity costs were worse than hoped and the hit has lasted longer than expected, though management sees it as temporary.
items.quote: Overall, commodities have been worse than we hoped. I do continue to believe that this is a temporary hit, but yes, it's definitely lasted a few quarters longer than I would have thought.

items.statement: Copper prices rose sharply on US pre-buying and AI demand, and plastics stayed disrupted because of the Hormuz crisis.
items.quote: Copper has run really far ahead, particularly because of pre-buying by US and much higher AI demand. Plastics also remain disrupted for much longer because of the Hormuz crisis.

items.statement: Memory chip costs remain complicated and expensive, with no near-term solution in sight.
items.quote: Unfortunately, memory has continued to be really, really complicated and expensive, and we don't see any near-term solution to that.

items.statement: The company will take no further price hikes in Q3 and will hold current prices for a while.
items.quote: No, we are not taking any more price hikes in Q3. As I guided the quarter before, we will stay put with these prices for a while.

items.statement: About 2.7% of the margin gain came from temporary levers such as SKU management and pullback of incentives.
items.quote: What's a little bit more lever kind or more temporary in nature are things like skew management and pullback of incentives or other other support mechanisms. In Q2, compared to Q4, that amounted to roughly about 2.7 percent.

items.statement: Management expects a comparable Kunark variant to carry six to seven percent better gross margins than Rista in the long term.
items.quote: I would not be surprised if like to like version of Kunark is six, seven percent better in gross margins to Rista in the long term.

items.statement: Hosur is adding 6,000 units per month of capacity that will go live later this quarter.
items.quote: With Hosur capacity expansion happening right away and incremental 6,000 units per month capacity that will go live this quarter

items.statement: Total installed capacity will rise from 9.2 lakh units to 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28.
items.quote: Taking our total installed capacity up from 9.2 lakh units, which is where we were we would have been by, let's say, middle of next year, to 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28.

items.statement: Trial production at Auric is expected to start within weeks, on track for Q3 FY27.
items.quote: Trial production is expected to start in the next few weeks, so very much on track for Q3 FY27.

items.statement: Capex and capacity installation at Auric phase one is expected to finish by Q4 FY27.
items.quote: And we expect to finish our Capex installation and hence capacity installation by Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Pre-orders rose 108%, registrations 60% and production 45% year on year.
items.quote: Pre-orders are up 108%, registrations are up 60%, production is up 45%, all year on year.

items.statement: The company estimates about 20,000 units per month of unmet retail demand.
items.quote: we our teams internal estimate is that we have roughly about 20,000 units per month of unrealized retail that we are not tapping into yet.

items.statement: E-two-wheeler penetration reached a record 11.6%, crossing double digits at a quarterly level for the first time.
items.quote: Important quarter for the industry with 11.6% e-two-wheeler penetration, highest ever, and the first time it's crossed into double digits at a quarterly level.

items.statement: The Kunark SR1 entry variant will launch by Q4 and is expected to drive much larger volumes.
items.quote: SR1 will go live a few months later. It'll go live by Q4. And and SR1 going live is the one that we obviously believe can drive a much larger volume.

items.statement: Dealer network expansion will restart in a big way from around the end of this quarter.
items.quote: expect us to start focusing on network expansion in a big way from the coming actually from pretty much end of this quarter itself.

items.statement: Management expects capacity expansion to start showing up in top-line results over the next few months.
items.quote: I'm very excited about the next few months as we start seeing results of all of this in the top line.

items.statement: Management noted a very volatile environment that makes cost and pricing hard to predict.
items.quote: But honestly, this world has been very volatile. So we can only we can only play it by the year.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: Very strong growth in gross margins despite almost frankly an unprecedented amount of commodity hits.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 1,450 bps year-on-year from minus 9.6% to positive 4.9%.
items.quote: EBITDA showing a 1,450 bps improvement year-on-year, from minus 9.6% in Q2 FY26 to positive 4.9% in Q2 FY27.

items.statement: Wholesale volume rose 42% year-on-year to 93,000 units.
items.quote: Wholesale volume grew from 65,000 units same time last year to 93,000 units in Q2, 42% growth year-on-year.

items.statement: The company hit positive PAT for the first time.
items.quote: And I would be remiss in not acknowledging the first time our business hit positive PAT, something definitely worth celebrating for us.

items.statement: Commodity inflation hit gross margins by 9.4%.
items.quote: Commodity inflation has come much worse than we would have liked, at a 9.4% hit to gross margins overall.

items.statement: Copper costs surged due to US prebuying and AI demand, and plastics stayed disrupted by the Hormuz crisis.
items.quote: Copper has run really far ahead, particularly because of prebuying by U.S. and much higher AI demand. Plastics also remained disrupted for much longer because of the Hormuz crisis.

items.statement: Memory chip costs remain expensive with no near-term solution seen.
items.quote: Unfortunately, memories continue to be really, really complicated and expensive, and we don't see any near-term solution to that.

items.statement: Weighted average ex-showroom price rose to INR164,000 in Q2 FY27 from about INR150,000 in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: That number for Q2 FY27 came in at INR164,000, so INR14,000 increase in average ex-showroom price.

items.statement: No further price hikes will be taken in Q3.
items.quote: No, we are not taking any more price hikes in Q3. As I guided the quarter before, we will stay put with these prices for a while.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin was 24%, up 1.6% over Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Netting out Q2 FY27 AGM at 24%, which is a 1.6% improvement over Q1 FY27, I think roughly, yes.

items.statement: Of the margin gains, 2.7% from SKU management is more temporary in nature.
items.quote: If either of this cools down, then we will probably open up this lever again. So TLDR, 2.7% is a bit more temporary in nature.

items.statement: Konarc could have 6-7% better gross margins than a comparable Rizta over the long term.
items.quote: I would not be surprised if a like-to-like version of Konarc is 6%, 7% better in gross margins to Rizta in the long-term.

items.statement: Hosur will add 6,000 units per month capacity later this quarter.
items.quote: Hosur capacity expansion happening right away, an incremental 6,000 units per month capacity that will go live this quarter -- later this quarter.

items.statement: AURIC Phase 1 will add 12,000 units per month by Q2 FY28, lifting installed capacity to 11.4 lakh units.
items.quote: AURIC Phase 1, an incremental 12,000 units per month incremental capacity that will go -

items.statement: AURIC trial production starts in weeks with capex installation completed by Q4 FY27.
items.quote: Trial production is expected to start in the next few weeks. So very much on track for Q3 FY27. And we expect to finish our capex installation and hence, capacity installation by Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Management estimates about 20,000 units per month of unmet retail demand.
items.quote: our team's internal estimate is that we have roughly about 20,000 units per month of unrealized retail that we are not tapping into yet.

items.statement: Inquiries rose 109% to over 10 lakh and preorders rose 108% to 1.8 lakh.
items.quote: Ather inquiries were up even more at about 109%, crossing 10 lakh inquiries for Q2 FY27. And preorders were up at about 108% year-on-year

items.statement: Pan-India E2W penetration crossed 10% for the first time and the industry remains supply constrained.
items.quote: Q2 was the first quarter when pan-India E2W penetration crossed 10%, netting out at about 11.2% for the full quarter.

items.statement: Ather launched fifth-generation Bedrock battery packs with 10-year or 1 lakh km warranties.
items.quote: are the first battery packs from Ather that come with 10 years or 1 lakh kilometer warranties with a 70% performance guarantee.

items.statement: Network expansion will restart in a big way with noticeable numbers from Q4.
items.quote: expect us to start focusing on network expansion in a big way from the coming -- actually from pretty much end of this quarter itself. So you will start seeing noticeable numbers from Q4 there.

items.statement: The Konarc entry variant SR1 will launch by Q4 when Aurangabad capacity is available.
items.quote: SR1 will go live a few months later. It will go live by Q4. And SR1 going live is the one that we obviously believe can drive a much larger volume.

items.statement: Management expects industry demand to remain healthy in coming quarters as it is still supply constrained.
items.quote: we do believe that this is still supply constrained at an industry level, and the coming quarters should continue to remain fairly healthy for the entire industry.

items.statement: Management cautioned the company is not out of the woods and PAT may fluctuate.
items.quote: I do want to call out, however, that we're not out of the woods. There's a lot of ops for us to deliver on.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: This has been a pretty stellar quarter for us, and I would say actually the entire industry with industry registrations hitting a growth of 82% year-on-year
